responsibility: Declares the public interface for GCC’s wide_int-based range operation library used by integer folding and value-range propagation. This header exposes helpers that derive result bounds, zero/nonzero bit masks, and special-case interval forms for multiplicative, shift, bitwise, abs, conversion, modulo, and division operations from wide_int endpoints, along with small inline predicates for zero inclusion, singleton zero, shift undefinedness, and min/max range combination. It is the companion interface to wide-int-range.cc, separating reusable range-computation APIs from callers in VRP and folding subsystems.
same_name_distinction: Provides the interface for the wide_int range library by declaring the helper routines implemented in wide-int-range.cc and by supplying lightweight inline predicates/utilities such as zero-in-range, zero-singleton, shift-undefined, and min/max range combination.
